criteria.label: 引用支持
criteria.description: Key empirical claims are backed by evidence IDs that were read and support the stated scope.

criteria.label: 推理错误
criteria.description: No state/trait conflation, no within-person correlation treated as a between-person effect, no decoding accuracy treated as mechanism.

criteria.label: 实验区分能力
criteria.description: The proposed experiment separates at least two competing explanations on the same observable and has a falsifier.

criteria.label: 可执行性
criteria.description: Data, design, controls, and analysis are specified enough to implement or reject.

criteria.label: 费用
criteria.description: The proposal's resource cost is proportionate; actual run cost is attributed separately.

note: This is dsh's initial review rubric, not a scientific truth score. Human review is required.
